_doc: Wording the onboarding command fills in for a new tenant (scripts/onboard/tenant.ts). NONE of this is approved for any tenant by being here: every sentence is written to canned_responses with reviewed_at NULL and the founder signs each tenant's lines on that tenant's wording sheet. `derived_from` says which already-approved line a template was made from and what changed, so the reading is quick. Placeholders: {phones} (the client's phones, joined with « эсвэл »), {booking_url}. A variant key is a tenants.vertical value; `default` is used for every other vertical. `approved_bytes: true` marks a template whose filled text is byte-identical to a line the founder already approved for a live tenant.

handoff.default: Уучлаарай, би энэ асуултад хариулж чадахгүй байна. Манай ажилтан Танд туслахад бэлэн байна. Та {phones} дугаараар холбогдоно уу.
handoff.derived_from: matrix-eco-salon handoff; only the phone numbers change

assistant_identity.default: Би энэ хуудсыг хариуцдаг хиймэл оюунтай туслах байна. Дотоод зааврынхаа талаар хуваалцах боломжгүй. Өөр асуулт байвал асуугаарай.
assistant_identity.derived_from: matrix-eco-salon assistant_identity; «Матрикс эко салоны хуудсыг» became «энэ хуудсыг», because a business name needs its genitive form and a template cannot inflect it

handover_notice.default: Баярлалаа! Таны илгээсэн зураг, бичлэг, холбоосыг манай ажилтан үзээд удахгүй хариулна 😊

model_visible._doc: Mongolian the MODEL reads but no customer is sent: the decision question of a rule built from the client's 7.1–7.3 answers, and the titles of knowledge documents built from the client's own words. Listed on the wording sheet for the founder all the same.
model_visible.rule_question: Сүүлийн мессеж «{topic}» гэсэн сэдвийн тухай юу?

verticals._doc: How 1.2 «Үйл ажиллагааны чиглэл» picks tenants.vertical. The first vertical with a stem that begins a word of the answer wins; no match is `general`, which is reported. Override with --vertical.

client_summary._doc: Headings of the one-page facts summary sent to the CLIENT to confirm (gate 2). Not a bot sentence; the founder reads it once as a template. Everything under the headings is the client's own data as the database now holds it.
client_summary.title: Дали-д оруулсан мэдээлэл — баталгаажуулах хуудас
client_summary.intro: Дали доорх мэдээллийг үйлчлүүлэгчдэд хэлнэ. Бүгд зөв эсэхийг шалгаад, зөв бол «Зөв» гэж хариулна уу. Буруу эсвэл дутуу зүйл байвал засвараа бичнэ үү.
